rules: Borders are derived from political facts and explicit geometry, not nearest-colony/Voronoi ownership.
Colonized systems do not automatically fill all space between them.
Unclaimed gaps, corridors, enclaves, shared regions and isolated holdings are valid.
A recognized treaty boundary overrides naive geometric inference.
Overlapping claims produce disputed_space unless an agreement defines a shared/neutral arrangement.
Neutral zones and demilitarized zones require explicit treaty/legal refs.
Unknown borders may remain approximate/unknown rather than being invented for map completeness.
Physical astrography remains independent from political overlay.
